recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for FHIR-32373. Revisit FHIR-53984 separately if the R6 RatioRange and path/searchParam invariant resolution becomes in scope for source-edit reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-32373 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested a DataRequirement.valueFilter element with path, searchParam, and value[x] choices for Quantity, string, boolean, integer, Range, Ratio, and originally SampledData; the final resolution accepted the change except that SampledData should not be a value choice.

additional_context: source/fhir.ini shows DataRequirement is active, mapped to metadatatypes, and normative. The FHIR Extension Pack cqf-valueFilter definition corroborates the boolean, string, integer, Quantity, Ratio, and Range type set. Later FHIR-53984 confirms the copied date/time type set is a mistake and proposes additional R6 work, but it is Resolved - change required rather than Applied/Published, so it was not decided here.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/datarequirement.xml so DataRequirement.valueFilter.value[x] allows boolean|string|integer|Quantity|Ratio|Range and updated its short description. dateFilter was left unchanged, and RatioRange/invariant work from FHIR-53984 was left for separate reconciliation.
source_changes: source/datatypes/datarequirement.xml: changed DataRequirement.valueFilter.value[x] type list from dateTime|Period|Duration to boolean|string|integer|Quantity|Ratio|Range.
source/datatypes/datarequirement.xml: updated the valueFilter.value[x] short description to name the non-code/non-date value types.
